name: es2/侠客行（南京河海大学校内版1.01）
english_name: Eastern Story II x Xiake Xing (Hohai University Campus Edition)
english_description: A hybrid of the ES2 and Xiake Xing ('The Wandering Knight') engine lineages, built as a computer-science-department test build at Hohai University in Nanjing. The content is still a work in progress, but the world already has personality — the pawnshop owner in Snow Pavilion Town is secretly a hidden master far stronger than any other early-game NPC, while the doorkeeper at the Chunfeng martial arts hall only fights seriously against his own sect's disciples, pulling his punches against everyone else.
